newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates finish higher, seen firmer.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates finish higher, seen firmer.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed higher on Tuesday and dealers expected the rates to gradually rise on Wednesday at the beginning of a new reserve period.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.317 percent against Monday's 5.216 close, with 30-day commercial paper slightly up at 5.20-5.35 against 5.20-5.25.
Dealers said year-end liquidity demand would start to emerge during the coming reserve period.
The bond market was slugglish in afternoon trade amid bearish outlook. The 10-year 84/1 bond yield was traded at 5.91 percent in early session. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
